data.name: Out Past the Horizon
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Your Tropical Paradise

Escape to a sun-drenched island where you hold the keys to the ultimate getaway. Whether you want to build a quiet solo homestead or run a bustling business empire with up to 8 players in online co-op, how you live is entirely up to you.

🌾 Cultivate & Commerce

  • Farm to Table: Cultivate a wide variety of tropical crops, tend to your fields solo, or divide farming chores with your friends.

  • Supply the Island: Deliver and sell your fresh harvest directly to local markets, busy individuals, and high-end restaurants.

  • Build an Empire: Step into management by owning, operating, and customizing your own storefronts, from a local pizza parlor to a bustling neighborhood supermarket.

🎣 Island Life & Exploration

  • Cast a Line: Grab your rod and fish from the shoreline, hop on a boat to explore remote islands, or relax on the water with your crew.

  • Deep Customization: Express yourself with detailed character customization options and an expansive wardrobe of stylish outfits.

  • Haggle with Locals: Use your charms to bargain and haggle with island vendors to get the best deals on rare supplies and decor.

🏝️ Wild Island Activities

Looking for a break from the daily grind? The island has plenty of surprises when you want to turn up the energy:

  • Party Minigames: Jump into fast-paced "hide and dodge" elimination games with your friends to see who survives the chaos.

  • Outrun the Law: Cause a little mischief around town and see if you have what it takes to dodge the local authorities.

  • Ultimate Relaxation: Or, simply kick back on the porch, sip a fresh cup of coffee, and watch the waves roll in.

English*, Japanese, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support
